name: Silfab Solar Inc.
old_description: Our superior-quality solar products deliver maximum power density, long-term reliability and are backed by one of the most trusted warranties in the industry.
about:
Silfab Solar Inc. operates its U.S. manufacturing headquarters in Burlington, Washington, with additional production facilities in Fort Mill, South Carolina, and a corporate office in Mississauga, Ontario. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but it identifies as a North American solar manufacturer with three domestic factories.

Silfab designs and manufactures photovoltaic modules for residential, commercial, and utility-scale markets. Its product lines include the Elite Series (back-contact technology, up to 420 W), Prime Series (black-on-black residential panels up to 440 W), Commercial Series (high-power-density modules up to 590 W), and Utility NTC bifacial panels (up to 640 W, nearly 23% efficiency). All three North American plants run fully automated production lines with advanced robotics and hold ISO 9001:2015 certification.

The company sells through distributors and installers across the United States and Canada. Its panels have been deployed in projects such as the YWCA Bellingham historic preservation retrofit, the Suquamish Tribe's solar-plus-storage installation, Infinity Drain's commercial rooftop in Massachusetts, Fisherman's Pavilion community solar in California, Brave & Maiden Estate in Oregon, and the SWIF RACK commercial array in Grants Pass, Oregon.

Silfab emphasizes that its panels are engineered specifically for North American climate conditions, citing low defect rates and one of the industry's most comprehensive warranties—25-year product and 30-year linear performance coverage on the Utility series. The Elite Series is marketed as exclusively made in the USA, using conductive backsheet and integrated cell designs to maximize light capture.
